messages:
maya: Kicking off a config-only deploy for routing weights + request timeout tweak. Change window tonight 2026-03-21 22:00–23:00 UTC. /deploy config-only queued.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued (cfg-6881). Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m observation windows. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate > 0.8% OR p95 latency increase > 60ms relative to baseline.

sam: Quick asks before we go: 1) release-notes snippet? 2) obs smoke checklist? 3) any tenants excluded from canary?

maya: Release notes (short): "Adjust default routing weight to favor low-latency pool; reduce per-request timeout from 3s -> 2.5s to fail fast on noisy backends." Observability smoke: synthetic traffic to /v1/generate at 3 qps, measure p50/p95, tail error rate. No tenant exclusions — targeting public tier only.

maya: Config diff I pushed to infra-configs (snippet):
```
routing:
  default_weight: 0.7
  low_latency_pool: 0.95
timeouts:
  request_ms: 2500
  kv_read_ms: 120
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  concurrency_soft_limit: 32
```

liam: I'll watch the dashboards and run the smoke suite. Paging threshold set to 2x baseline error rate or p95 > 220ms. I'll post interim updates.

anya: Can we pin the model variant for the canary traffic so we avoid model churn compounding config noise? If yes, please add model: "stable-v2" to canary routing.

maya: Good call — added pin to canary routing in the config.

oncall-sre: Oncall ready. If deploy-bot reports canary fail we'll follow rollback playbook: 1) unroute canary, 2) set weights back to previous commit, 3) open a postmortem thread.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 5% at 1717505432. Observing for 15m windows.

liam: Smoke results (5m in): p50 42ms, p95 168ms, error rate 0.05%. No anomalies.

maya: Proceed to 25% when deploy-bot is ready.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 25% at 1717507720. Next observation window 15m.

liam: 10m into 25%: p95 174ms, error rate 0.06%. All looks healthy.

sam: tagging release-notes: "routing weight rebalancing; minor timeout reduction to improve fail-fast behavior; canary pinned to stable-v2."

maya: If nothing spikes, we plan full 100% at 22:45 UTC. If any metric crosses thresholds, we auto-rollback and ops will enact the rollback playbook.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. Monitoring channel: #prod-observability.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100% at 1717509821. No auto-rollbacks triggered. :tada:
